scope: Four authored fish presentation types with raw/cooked pairs and C1 scale anchors; not new game catalogue activation or zoological certification.
owner_authority: Fish may vary by size and type. Selected core R4 supplies small presentation and selected conveyor R1 supplies the accepted larger presentation.

types.name: common fish
types.finding: Canonical blue-gray, cream-bellied orange-fin raw fish; warm cooked counterpart.

types.name: perch
types.finding: Olive/gold striped authored raw type and same-size cooked presentation.

types.name: trout
types.finding: Longer spotted raw type with pink side band; cooked form retains length and silhouette.

types.name: salmon
types.finding: Long silver-blue raw type with dark fins; cooked counterpart retains the large elongated shape.

checks: Distinct small, intermediate and large presentation is visible without shrinking C1 between panels.
Each raw/cooked pair preserves its own approximate size, tail/fins and silhouette.
All eight fish and full C1 anchors fit within panels; labels readable and ground support visible.
Common raw identity remains recognizable against canonical fish reference.
